method: Candidate pool from scripts/reading_pool.py (title-pattern facets ranked by in-library citations); selection by the orchestrator (Claude Opus 5.5) from titles/venues/years/citation counts, not full text. A reading list is a discovery decision, not evidence.

xai_credit.rationale: Core facet (explainability applied to credit decisions). All papers cited by >=1 other included paper, minus fraud/churn/insurance; plus uncited recent papers on explanation evaluation, stability, adverse-action reasons and EU/UK legal fit of credit explanations (the thesis's direct neighbours, too recent to be cited).
